new_relations.title: Parental formation is judged by later fruit
new_relations.project_anchor: The project treats healthy Father/Gardener roles as developmental: correction should increase capability and future fruit rather than become domination.
new_relations.biblical_structure: parental discipline is framed as difficult formation whose stated outcome is later peaceful fruit
new_relations.source_direction: Project formation/fruit ethic first; Hebrews comparison later.
new_relations.mismatch: The passage does not justify arbitrary coercion, abuse or every claimed act of correction.
